grandparents_cupboard.reason: Puff pastry, Dijon mustard, cheddar, cooked ham, tomatoes, egg, oil and rocket are all ordinary home kitchen foods.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream UK supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: A baking tray, grater and pastry brush are ordinary kit, and scoring a border on ready-rolled pastry is beginner-level.

works.reason: A 320g sheet of ready-rolled puff at 220°C for 25 to 30 minutes, with cheese under the tomatoes, gives a crisp tart that makes a fair lunch for four with the rocket.

honest_times.reason: Grating 75g cheese, slicing 500g tomatoes, tearing ham and beating an egg fits in 15 minutes, and the 30 minute cook matches the bake.

honest_ingredients.reason: Each name matches its id, and every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the thyme, salt and pepper, is used in the steps with nothing extra.

seasonal_feel.reason: A tomato tart in mid-June suits the weather, and the tomatoes are the main topping.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, plain British English with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Pastry with ham, cheese, plenty of tomatoes and a rocket salad is a proper family lunch.
